statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. NQ continuous trading is paused for Labor Day, so there is no current live price path with which to verify persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Current policy mapping remains WATCH. The key structural checkpoint is the 22:00 UTC Globex reopen; an unrepaired gap with shallow or failed retracements would raise Tail, while two-sided price discovery would lower it.
headline: Holiday halt leaves Tail at WATCH ahead of the 22:00 UTC NQ reopen
body: Current Tail is limited by the absence of live NQ structure during the Labor Day trading pause. Fresh shared Finviz evidence is supplementary and mixed, while Reuters reports Brent near six-week highs amid renewed U.S.-Iran maritime escalation and strong U.S. jobs data has increased Fed-tightening expectations.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock-hours, published ChatGPT assessments kept Stress at 100 and dominant mode at event/whipsaw. Tail was mostly WATCH at 20-24, briefly LOW at 18-19 from 13:00-16:00 UTC, then returned to 24 as the holiday trading halt began.
outlookSummary: The highest conditional Tail is concentrated around the 22:00 UTC futures reopen, peaking at 32 at 23:00 UTC only if a directional gap resists repair and failed retracements repeat. Risk returns toward WATCH if price discovery becomes two-sided. The next verified U.S. data cluster starts with Consumer Credit on September 8.

forecastDetail.comment: NQ continuous trading is paused for Labor Day, so no current one-way price path can be observed. Fresh shared Finviz context is delayed and mixed: NQ was modestly positive, semiconductors strong, and megacaps mixed. Oil/Hormuz escalation keeps Stress extreme.

If the holiday pause persists without new verified market information, Tail stays at WATCH rather than rising on headlines alone. The relevant checkpoint is the approaching Globex reopen, while oil and Fed repricing continue to keep Stress extreme.

With the reopen less than an hour away, conditional gap risk becomes more important, but no future directional structure is assumed. Tail remains WATCH unless the reopening setup shows a persistent imbalance rather than ordinary price discovery.

At the expected Globex reopen, Tail rises conditionally into the elevated band only if a directional gap resists repair and early pullbacks are shallow or fail. A two-sided reopening or meaningful gap repair would argue against the elevated path.

During the first full post-reopen hour, the highest conditional Tail reflects the risk of repeated extension after failed retracements. If price instead rotates through both sides of the opening range, this elevated scenario would weaken quickly.

By the second post-reopen hour, Tail remains elevated only if the initial move still resists meaningful retracement and cross-asset stress remains aligned. Gap repair, volatility decay, or two-sided rotation would favor a rapid return toward WATCH.
